thread:
elena (PM): quick sync — we need to lock the plan for the waveform post-launch iteration. main question: how much of the next week is for bugs vs enhancements?

sam (eng): leaning 60/40 bugs. we still have the streaming regression and two memory leak reports from canary.

tara (CS): +1 on regression priority — customer A and C hit it in staging, one has a tight SLA. they asked for a patch.

elena (PM): ok that pushes severity. proposal: carve out a 2-day hotfix window (canary -> prod) then dedicate rest to a small enhancements list (UX + 1 perf). thoughts?

mike (sre): 2-day hotfix sounds fine if we can freeze other deploys. I'll reserve a maintenance window Thu 10:00–14:00 PT. deploy-bot will tag canaries.

sam (eng): can do. quick checklist: 1) reproduce regression with new trace (need logs), 2) hotpatch branch, 3) smoke test harness run. I'll post a failing reproducer in a sec.

alex (design): on enhancements, we really should keep the compact controls tweak — small UX step, low risk. but don't want it to block the hotfix path.

tara (CS): also flag customer B's request for better error messaging — low effort, high signal. could be slotted into the enhancement slice.

elena (PM): priority order for next sprint: 1) streaming regression hotfix (canary -> prod), 2) memory leak patch, 3) error messaging (customer B), 4) compact controls UX. rollback plan: if hotfix causes perf regress, auto-fallback to previous model route.

sam (eng): reproducer posted: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood/run -d '{"prompt":"stream test","stream":true,"max_tokens":2000}'``` logs show KV-cache growth after ~600 tokens. investigating.

mike (sre): adding SLO guard: if p95 token latency > 1s during canary window, I'll throttle new requests and cut traffic.

elena (PM): decision: freeze minor feature merges until Friday EOD, allow hotfix and critical patches only. backlog groom tomorrow; bring a trimmed enhancement list (2 items) for triage.

tara (CS): I'll message the affected customers and set expectations for an ETA after hotfix.

sam (eng): ETA for a working patch is EOD tomorrow if reproducer is stable. will post CI run results.

deploy-bot: canary deployment scheduled by mike for Thu 10:00 PT, job #deploy-2165439123-canary queued. :rocket:

elena (PM): great — I'll update the roadmap board (kanban) and note the freeze + hotfix window. assign owners after CI results. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
